shloka_text: ततो वित्रासयन्मर्त्यान्पृथिव्यां राक्षसाधिपः । आससाद घने तस्मिन्नारदं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। 7.20.1 ।।
transliteration: tato vitrāsayanmartyānpṛthivyāṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ | āsasāda ghane tasminnāradaṃ munipuṅgavam || 7.20.1 ||
translation: ततः then, वित्रासयन् terrifying, मर्त्यान् mortals, पृथिव्याम् on earth, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of demons, आससाद met, घने in that dense (region), तस्मिन् that, नारदम् Narada, मुनिपुङ्गवम् the foremost among sages.
explanation: Then, the lord of demons, terrifying mortals on earth, met Narada, the foremost among sages, in that dense region.
comments: Ravana meets the sage Narada, who, to turn him from tormenting the already death-bound mortal world, counsels that to conquer Yama is to conquer all -- delighted, Ravana vows to subdue Death and the world-guardians and sets off southward to Yama's abode -- marvelling that any could conquer Yama, Narada follows to witness the clash.

shloka_text: तस्याभिवादनं कृत्वा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः । अब्रवीत्कुशलं पृष्ट्वा हेतुमागमनस्य च ।। 7.20.2 ।।
transliteration: tasyābhivādanaṃ kṛtvā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ | abravītkuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā hetumāgamanasya ca || 7.20.2 ||
translation: तस्य his, अभिवादनम् salutation, कृत्वा having done, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, अब्रवीत् spoke, कुशलम् well-being, पृष्ट्वा having asked, हेतुम् the reason, आगमनस्य for coming, च and.
explanation: Having offered his salutations, Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, spoke after inquiring about his well-being and the reason for his arrival.

shloka_text: नारदस्तु महातेजा देवर्षिरमितप्रभः । अब्रवीन्मेघपृष्ठस्थो रावणं पुष्पके स्थितम् ।। 7.20.3 ।।
transliteration: nāradastu mahātejā devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ | abravīnmeghapṛṣṭhastho rāvaṇaṃ puṣpake sthitam || 7.20.3 ||
translation: नारदः Narada, तु indeed, महातेजा of great splendor, देवर्षिः the divine sage, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable effulgence, अब्रवीत् spoke, मेघपृष्ठस्थः situated on a cloud-top, रावणं to Ravana, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka (chariot), स्थितम् who was situated.
explanation: The divine sage Narada, of immense splendor and effulgence, spoke to Ravana, who was seated in the Pushpaka chariot, while Narada himself was positioned on a cloud-top.

shloka_text: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य तिष्ठ विश्रवसः सुत । प्रीतो ऽस्म्यभिजनोपेतविक्रमैरूर्जितैस्तव ।। 7.20.4 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasādhipate saumya tiṣṭha viśravasaḥ suta | prīto 'smyabhijanopetavikramairūrjitaistava || 7.20.4 ||
translation: राक्षसाधिपते O lord of Rakshasas, सौम्य O gentle one, तिष्ठ stop, विश्रवसः of Vishravas, सुत O son, प्रीतो pleased, अस्मि I am, अभिजनोपेतविक्रमैः by valor endowed with noble birth, ऊर्जितैः mighty, तव your.
explanation: "O gentle lord of Rakshasas, son of Vishravas, stop," Narada said, "I am pleased by your mighty valor, which is befitting your noble lineage."

shloka_text: विष्णुना दैत्यघातैश्च गन्धर्वोरगधर्षणैः । त्वया समं विमर्दैश्च भृशं हि परितोषितः ।। 7.20.5 ।।
transliteration: viṣṇunā daityaghātaiśca gandharvoragadharṣaṇaiḥ | tvayā samaṃ vimardaiśca bhṛśaṃ hi paritoṣitaḥ || 7.20.5 ||
translation: विष्णुना by Vishnu, दैत्यघातैः by the slaying of Daityas, च and, गन्धर्वोरगधर्षणैः by the subjugation of Gandharvas and Uragas, त्वया by you, समं equal, विमर्दैः by battles, च and, भृशं greatly, हि indeed, परितोषितः I am pleased.
explanation: I am indeed greatly pleased by your battles, which are comparable to Vishnu's slaying of demons and your subjugation of Gandharvas and Uragas.

shloka_text: किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तावत्ते श्रोतव्यं श्रोष्यसे यदि । श्रुत्वा चानन्तरं कार्यं त्वया राक्षससत्तम । तन्मे निगदतस्तात समाधिं श्रवणे कुरु ।। 7.20.6 ।।
transliteration: kiṃcidvakṣyāmi tāvatte śrotavyaṃ śroṣyase yadi | śrutvā cānantaraṃ kāryaṃ tvayā rākṣasasattama | tanme nigadatastāta samādhiṃ śravaṇe kuru || 7.20.6 ||
translation: किंचित् something, वक्ष्यामि I will say, तावत् first, ते to you, श्रोतव्यं to be heard, श्रोष्यसे you will hear, यदि if, श्रुत्वा having heard, च and, अनन्तरं afterwards, कार्यं to be done, त्वया by you, राक्षससत्तम O best of Rakshasas, तत् that, मे by me, निगदतः while speaking, तात O dear one, समाधिं attention, श्रवणे in listening, कुरु make.
explanation: I will first tell you something that should be heard, if you are willing to listen, and after hearing it, you, O best of Rakshasas, must act upon it; therefore, O dear one, pay close attention to my words.

shloka_text: किमयं वध्यते तात त्वया ऽवध्येन दैवतैः । हत एव ह्ययं लोको यदा मृत्युवशं गतः ।। 7.20.7 ।। ्तम ।
transliteration: kimayaṃ vadhyate tāta tvayā 'vadhyena daivataiḥ | hata eva hyayaṃ loko yadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ || 7.20.7 || ्tama |
translation: किम् why, अयं this (world/people), वध्यते is being killed, तात O dear one, त्वया by you, अवध्येन who is not to be killed, दैवतैः by gods, हतः killed, एव indeed, हि surely, अयं this, लोकः world/people, यदा when, मृत्युवशं under the sway of death, गतः gone.
explanation: O dear one, why do you kill this world, which is already destined to die and cannot be killed by the gods, when it is already under the sway of death?

shloka_text: देवदानवदैत्यानां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् । अवध्येन त्वया लोकः क्लेष्टुं युक्तो न मानुषः ।। 7.20.8 ।।
transliteration: devadānavadaityānāṃ yakṣagandharvarakṣasām | avadhyena tvayā lokaḥ kleṣṭuṃ yukto na mānuṣaḥ || 7.20.8 ||
translation: देवदानवदैत्यानां of gods, danavas, and daityas, यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् of yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, अवध्येन by one who is not to be killed, त्वया by you, लोकः the world, क्लेष्टुं to torment, युक्तो fit, न not, मानुषः human.
explanation: It is not proper for you, who are invincible to gods, danavas, daityas, yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, to torment the human world.

shloka_text: नित्यं श्रेयसि सम्मूढं महद्भिर्व्यसनैर्वृतम् । हन्यात्कस्तादृशं लोकं जराव्याधिशतैर्युतम् ।। 7.20.9 ।।
transliteration: nityaṃ śreyasi sammūḍhaṃ mahadbhirvyasanairvṛtam | hanyātkastādṛśaṃ lokaṃ jarāvyādhiśatairyutam || 7.20.9 ||
translation: नित्यं constantly, श्रेयसि in welfare, सम्मूढं bewildered, महद्भिः by great, व्यसनैः calamities, वृतम् surrounded, हन्यात् would kill, कः who, तादृशं such, लोकं people, जराव्याधिशतैः by hundreds of old age and diseases, युतम् afflicted.
explanation: Who would kill such people who are constantly bewildered about their welfare, surrounded by great misfortunes, and afflicted by hundreds of old age and diseases?

shloka_text: तैस्तैरनिष्टोपगमैरजस्रं यत्र कुत्र कः । मतिमान्मानुषे लोके युद्धेन प्रणयी भवेत् ।। 7.20.10 ।।
transliteration: taistairaniṣṭopagamairajasraṃ yatra kutra kaḥ | matimānmānuṣe loke yuddhena praṇayī bhavet || 7.20.10 ||
translation: तैस्तैः by those various, अनिष्टोपगमैः by undesirable occurrences, अजस्रं constantly, यत्र where, कुत्र anywhere, कः who, मतिमान् intelligent, मानुषे in the human, लोके world, युद्धेन by war, प्रणयी desirous, भवेत् would be.
explanation: Who among the intelligent would be fond of war in the human world, which is constantly afflicted by various undesirable occurrences everywhere?

shloka_text: क्षीयमाणं दैवहतं श्रुत्पिपासाजरादिभिः । विषादशोकसम्मूढं लोकं त्वं क्षपयस्व मा ।। 7.20.11 ।।
transliteration: kṣīyamāṇaṃ daivahataṃ śrutpipāsājarādibhiḥ | viṣādaśokasammūḍhaṃ lokaṃ tvaṃ kṣapayasva mā || 7.20.11 ||
translation: क्षीयमाणं wasting away, दैवहतं struck by fate, श्रुत्पिपासाजरादिभिः by hunger, thirst, old age, and others, विषादशोकसम्मूढं bewildered by dejection and sorrow, लोकं people, त्वं you, क्षपयस्व destroy, मा not.
explanation: Do not you destroy the human world, which is already wasting away, struck by fate, afflicted by hunger, thirst, old age, and other miseries, and bewildered by dejection and sorrow.

shloka_text: पश्य तावन्महाबाहो राक्षसेश्वर मानुषम् । मूढमेवं विचित्रार्थं यस्य न ज्ञायते गतिः ।। 7.20.12 ।।
transliteration: paśya tāvanmahābāho rākṣaseśvara mānuṣam | mūḍhamevaṃ vicitrārthaṃ yasya na jñāyate gatiḥ || 7.20.12 ||
translation: पश्य behold, तावत just, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, राक्षसेश्वर O lord of Rakshasas, मानुषम् human being, मूढम् foolish, एवम् thus, विचित्रार्थं having strange purposes, यस्य whose, न not, ज्ञायते is known, गतिः destiny.
explanation: O mighty-armed lord of Rakshasas, just behold the human being, who is so foolish and whose strange nature or destiny is not truly known.

shloka_text: क्वचिद्वादित्रनृत्यादि सेव्यते मुदितैर्जनैः । रुद्यते चापरैरार्तैर्धाराश्रुनयनाननैः ।। 7.20.13 ।।
transliteration: kvacidvāditranṛtyādi sevyate muditairjanaiḥ | rudyate cāparairārtairdhārāśrunayanānanaiḥ || 7.20.13 ||
translation: क्वचित् at times, वादित्रनृत्यादि musical instruments and dance etc., सेव्यते are enjoyed, मुदितैः by joyful, जनैः people, रुद्यते is wept, च and, अपरैः by others, आर्तैः by distressed, धाराश्रुनयनाननैः with faces and eyes streaming with tears.
explanation: At times, joyful people engage in music and dance, while at other times, distressed individuals weep with faces and eyes streaming with tears.

shloka_text: मातापितृसुतस्नेहैर्भार्याबन्धुमनोरमैः । मोहितो ऽयं जनो ध्वस्तः क्लेशं स्वं नावबुध्यते ।। 7.20.14 ।।
transliteration: mātāpitṛsutasnehairbhāryābandhumanoramaiḥ | mohito 'yaṃ jano dhvastaḥ kleśaṃ svaṃ nāvabudhyate || 7.20.14 ||
translation: मातापितृसुतस्नेहैः by the affections for mother, father, and son, भार्याबन्धुमनोरमैः by charming wife and relatives, मोहितः deluded, अयम् this, जनः person, ध्वस्तः afflicted, क्लेशम् suffering, स्वम् own, न not, अवबुध्यते understands.
explanation: Deluded by affection for parents, children, charming wives, and relatives, this afflicted person does not comprehend his own suffering.

shloka_text: अलमेनं परिक्लिश्य लोकं मोहनिराकृतम् । जित एव त्वया सौम्य मर्त्यलोको न संशयः ।। 7.20.15 ।।
transliteration: alamenaṃ parikliśya lokaṃ mohanirākṛtam | jita eva tvayā saumya martyaloko na saṃśayaḥ || 7.20.15 ||
translation: अलम् enough, एनम् this, परिक्लिश्य having tormented, लोकम् world, मोहनिराकृतम् overcome by delusion, जितः conquered, एव indeed, त्वया by you, सौम्य O gentle one, मर्त्यलोकः the mortal world, न not, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Enough of tormenting this world, which is already overcome by delusion; O gentle one, the mortal world has indeed been conquered by you, there is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: अवश्यमेभिः सर्वैश्च गन्तव्यं यमसादनम् । तन्निगृह्णीष्व पौलस्त्य यमं परपुरञ्जय ।। 7.20.16 ।।
transliteration: avaśyamebhiḥ sarvaiśca gantavyaṃ yamasādanam | tannigṛhṇīṣva paulastya yamaṃ parapurañjaya || 7.20.16 ||
translation: अवश्यम् inevitably, एभिः by these, सर्वैः all, च and, गन्तव्यम् must go, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, तत् therefore, निगृह्णीष्व subdue, पौलस्त्य O son of Pulastya, यमम् Yama, परपुरञ्जय O conqueror of enemy cities.
explanation: All these beings must inevitably go to the abode of Yama, therefore, O son of Pulastya, O conqueror of enemy cities, subdue Yama himself.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्जिते जितं सर्वं भवत्येव न संशयः । एवमुक्तस्तु लङ्केशो दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । अब्रवीन्नारदं तत्र सम्प्रहस्याभिवाद्य च ।। 7.20.17 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñjite jitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | evamuktastu laṅkeśo dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā | abravīnnāradaṃ tatra samprahasyābhivādya ca || 7.20.17 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, जिते is conquered, जितम् conquered, सर्वम् all, भवति becomes, एव indeed, न not, संशयः doubt, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, दीप्यमानम् shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, अब्रवीत् spoke, नारदम् to Narada, तत्र there, सम्प्रहस्य having laughed heartily, अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and.
explanation: When Yama is conquered, everything is indeed conquered, there is no doubt; thus addressed, the lord of Lanka, shining with his own splendor, then spoke to Narada, having laughed heartily and saluted him.

shloka_text: महर्षे देवगन्धर्वविहार समरप्रिय । अहं समुद्यतो गन्तुं विजयार्थं रसातलम् ।। 7.20.18 ।।
transliteration: maharṣe devagandharvavihāra samarapriya | ahaṃ samudyato gantuṃ vijayārthaṃ rasātalam || 7.20.18 ||
translation: महर्षे O great sage, देवगन्धर्वविहार O one who sports with gods and gandharvas, समरप्रिय O lover of battle, अहम् I, समुद्यतः am ready, गन्तुम् to go, विजयार्थम् for the sake of victory, रसातलम् to Rasatala.
explanation: Ravana addresses the sage, declaring his readiness to descend to Rasatala for conquest.

shloka_text: ततो लोकत्रयं जित्वा स्थाप्य नागान्सुरान्वशे । समुद्रममृतार्थं च मथिष्यामि रसालयम् ।। 7.20.19 ।।
transliteration: tato lokatrayaṃ jitvā sthāpya nāgānsurānvaśe | samudramamṛtārthaṃ ca mathiṣyāmi rasālayam || 7.20.19 ||
translation: ततः Then, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, जित्वा having conquered, स्थाप्य having placed, नागान् the Nagas, सुरान् the gods, वशे under control, समुद्रम् the ocean, अमृतार्थम् for the sake of nectar, च and, मथिष्यामि I will churn, रसालयम् the abode of waters.
explanation: Ravana further states that after conquering the three worlds and subjugating the Nagas and gods, he will churn the ocean for nectar.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीदृशग्रीवं नारदो भगवानृषिः । क्व खल्विदानीं मार्गेण त्वया ह्यन्येन गम्यते ।। 7.20.20 ।।
transliteration: athābravīdṛśagrīvaṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ | kva khalvidānīṃ mārgeṇa tvayā hyanyena gamyate || 7.20.20 ||
translation: अथ Then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, नारदः Narada, भगवान् the divine, ऋषिः sage, क्व where, खलु indeed, इदानीम् now, मार्गेण by which path, त्वया by you, हि surely, अन्येन by another, गम्यते is it gone (are you going).
explanation: Then, the divine sage Narada asked Ravana, "By which path are you indeed going now?"

shloka_text: अयं खलु सुदुर्गम्यः प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति । मार्गो गच्छति दुर्धर्षो यमस्यामित्रकर्शन ।। 7.20.21 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ khalu sudurgamyaḥ pretarājapuraṃ prati | mārgo gacchati durdharṣo yamasyāmitrakarśana || 7.20.21 ||
translation: अयम् This, खलु indeed, सुदुर्गम्यः very difficult to traverse, प्रेतराजपुरम् to the city of the king of the dead, प्रति towards, मार्गः path, गच्छति goes, दुर्धर्षः unassailable, यमस्य of Yama, अमित्रकर्शन O tormentor of enemies.
explanation: Narada warns Ravana that this path, O tormentor of enemies, is indeed very difficult to traverse and leads to the formidable city of Yama, the king of the dead.

shloka_text: स तु शारदमेघाभं हासं मुक्त्वा दशाननः । उवाच कृतमित्येव वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.20.22 ।।
transliteration: sa tu śāradameghābhaṃ hāsaṃ muktvā daśānanaḥ | uvāca kṛtamityeva vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.20.22 ||
translation: सः He, तु but, शारदमेघाभम् resembling an autumn cloud, हासम् a laugh, मुक्त्वा having let out, दशाननः Dashanana, उवाच said, कृतम् done, इति एव thus only, वचनम् words, च and, इदम् these, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Dashanana, however, let out a laugh resembling an autumn cloud and then spoke these words, saying, "It is done."

shloka_text: तस्मादेवमहं ब्रह्मन् वैवस्वतवधोद्यतः । गच्छामि दक्षिणामाशां यत्र सूर्यात्मजो नृपः ।। 7.20.23 ।।
transliteration: tasmādevamahaṃ brahman vaivasvatavadhodyataḥ | gacchāmi dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ yatra sūryātmajo nṛpaḥ || 7.20.23 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, एवम् thus, अहम् I, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, वैवस्वतवधोद्यतः intent on killing Vaivasvata (Yama), गच्छामि I go, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् direction, यत्र where, सूर्यात्मजः the son of Surya, नृपः the king.
explanation: Therefore, O Brahmana, being thus intent on slaying Vaivasvata (Yama), I proceed to the southern direction where the son of Surya, the king (Yama), resides.

shloka_text: मया हि भगवन्क्रोधात्प्रतिज्ञातं रणार्थिना । अवजेष्यामि चतुरो लोकपालानिति प्रभो ।। 7.20.24 ।।
transliteration: mayā hi bhagavankrodhātpratijñātaṃ raṇārthinā | avajeṣyāmi caturo lokapālāniti prabho || 7.20.24 ||
translation: मया by me, हि indeed, भगवन् O revered one, क्रोधात् out of anger, प्रतिज्ञातम् it has been vowed, रणार्थिना by one desirous of battle, अवजेष्यामि I shall conquer, चतुरः the four, लोकपालान् guardians of the world, इति thus, प्रभो O lord.
explanation: Indeed, O revered one, I, desirous of battle, have vowed in my anger, "I shall conquer the four guardians of the world, O lord."

shloka_text: तदिह प्रस्थितो ऽहं वै प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति । प्राणिसङ्क्लेशकर्तारं योजयिष्यामि मृत्युना ।। 7.20.25 ।।
transliteration: tadiha prasthito 'haṃ vai pretarājapuraṃ prati | prāṇisaṅkleśakartāraṃ yojayiṣyāmi mṛtyunā || 7.20.25 ||
translation: तत् therefore, इह now, प्रस्थितः having set out, अहम् I, वै indeed, प्रेतराजपुरम् to the city of the king of the dead, प्रति towards, प्राणिसङ्क्लेशकर्तारम् the one who causes distress to living beings, योजयिष्यामि I shall unite, मृत्युना with death.
explanation: Therefore, I have now indeed set out towards the city of the king of the dead, and I shall unite with death the one who causes distress to living beings.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मुनिं तमभिवाद्य च । प्रययौ दक्षिणामाशां प्रविष्टः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।। 7.20.26 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvo muniṃ tamabhivādya ca | prayayau dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ praviṣṭaḥ saha mantribhiḥ || 7.20.26 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), मुनिम् the sage, तम् him, अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and, प्रययौ he departed, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् direction, प्रविष्टः having entered, सह with, मन्त्रिभिः his ministers.
explanation: Having thus spoken and saluted that sage, Dashagriva (Ravana) departed towards the southern direction, accompanied by his ministers.

shloka_text: नारदस्तु महातेजा मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थितः । चिन्तयामास विप्रेन्द्रो विधूम इव पावकः ।। 7.20.27 ।।
transliteration: nāradastu mahātejā muhūrtaṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥ | cintayāmāsa viprendro vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ || 7.20.27 ||
translation: नारदः Narada, तु but, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यानम् meditation, आस्थितः having assumed, चिन्तयामास he pondered, विप्रेन्द्रः the chief among Brahmanas, विधूमः smokeless, इव like, पावकः fire.
explanation: But the greatly effulgent Narada, the chief among Brahmanas, having assumed meditation for a moment, pondered like a smokeless fire.

shloka_text: येन लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः क्लिश्यन्ते सचराचराः । क्षीणे चायुषि धर्मेण स कालो जेष्यते कथम् ।। 7.20.28 ।।
transliteration: yena lokāstrayaḥ sendrāḥ kliśyante sacarācarāḥ | kṣīṇe cāyuṣi dharmeṇa sa kālo jeṣyate katham || 7.20.28 ||
translation: येन by whom, लोकाः worlds, त्रयः three, सेन्द्राः including Indra, क्लिश्यन्ते are tormented, सचराचराः with all moving and non-moving beings, क्षीणे when exhausted, च and, आयुषि in lifespan, धर्मेण by the law of nature/dharma, सः that, कालः Time/Death, जेष्यते will be conquered, कथम् how
explanation: How can that Time, by whom the three worlds including Indra and all animate and inanimate beings are tormented, and by whose law life itself is exhausted, ever be conquered?

shloka_text: स्वदत्तकृतसाक्षी यो द्वितीय इव पावकः । लब्धसञ्ज्ञा विजेष्यन्ते लोका यस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.20.29 ।।
transliteration: svadattakṛtasākṣī yo dvitīya iva pāvakaḥ | labdhasañjñā vijeṣyante lokā yasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.20.29 ||
translation: स्वदत्तकृतसाक्षी who is a witness to one's own deeds, यः who, द्वितीयः second, इव like, पावकः fire, लब्धसञ्ज्ञाः having gained consciousness, विजेष्यन्ते will be conquered, लोकाः worlds, यस्य whose, महात्मनः of the great soul (Yama)
explanation: How can one conquer that great being (Yama), who is a witness to all deeds, like a second fire, and by whom all conscious beings in the worlds are eventually overcome?

shloka_text: यस्य नित्यं त्रयो लोका विद्रवन्ति भयार्दिताः । तं कथं राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽसौ स्वयमेव गमिष्यति ।। 7.20.30 ।।
transliteration: yasya nityaṃ trayo lokā vidravanti bhayārditāḥ | taṃ kathaṃ rākṣasendro 'sau svayameva gamiṣyati || 7.20.30 ||
translation: यस्य from whom, नित्यं always, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, विद्रवन्ति flee, भयार्दिताः tormented by fear, तं him, कथं how, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rakshasas, असौ this, स्वयमेव by himself, गमिष्यति will go (to conquer)
explanation: How can this king of Rakshasas (Ravana) personally go to conquer him, from whom the three worlds always flee, tormented by fear?

shloka_text: यो विधाता च धाता च सुकृतं दुष्कृतं तथा । त्रैलोक्यं विजितं येन तं कथं विजयिष्यते ।। 7.20.31 ।।
transliteration: yo vidhātā ca dhātā ca sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tathā | trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ yena taṃ kathaṃ vijayiṣyate || 7.20.31 ||
translation: यः who, विधाता the ordainer, च and, धाता the sustainer, च and, सुकृतं good deeds, दुष्कृतं bad deeds, तथा also, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, विजितं conquered, येन by whom, तं him, कथं how, विजयिष्यते will he conquer
explanation: How will he conquer him who is the ordainer and sustainer of both good and bad deeds, and by whom the three worlds are already subdued?

shloka_text: अपरं किन्तु कृत्वायं विधानं संविधास्यति । कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नो यास्यामि यमसादनम् ।। 7.20.32 ।।
transliteration: aparaṃ kintu kṛtvāyaṃ vidhānaṃ saṃvidhāsyati | kautūhalasamutpanno yāsyāmi yamasādanam || 7.20.32 ||
translation: अपरं what else, किन्तु but, कृत्वा having done, अयं this (Ravana), विधानं arrangement, संविधास्यति will make, कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नः filled with curiosity, यास्यामि I will go, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama
explanation: What other plan will this Ravana make after this, but filled with curiosity, I myself will go to the abode of Yama.

shloka_text: विमर्दं द्रष्टुमनयोर्यमराक्षसयोः स्वयम् ।। 7.20.33 ।।
transliteration: vimardaṃ draṣṭumanayoryamarākṣasayoḥ svayam || 7.20.33 ||
translation: विमर्दं conflict, द्रष्टुम् to see, अनयोः of these two, यमराक्षसयोः of Yama and the Rakshasa, स्वयम् himself,
explanation: He himself wished to witness the conflict between Yama and the Rakshasa. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे विंशः सर्गः ।। 20 ।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
